builtFrom.catalog: code read through the repo's Atlas map when it has one, else the plan's code scope; described with Foundry's catalog describer prompts
builtFrom.method: three independent model proposals, item-level majority vote (2 of 3), seams to the size ceiling, per-region authoring

concepts.description: Get a PrismaMap from a generated client: buildPrismaMapV7 (internal/class.ts) / buildPrismaMapV6 (schema.prisma), optional path, auto-detection walking up from cwd and its errors

The low-level pieces the builders compose: ./v7 parseRuntimeDataModel, parseInlineSchema, parseRelationFks, parseEnumValues; ./v6 parseSchemaText, buildFromSchemaFile; internal schemaText line helpers (comment stripping, @map/@@map matching)
Installing and importing: the root entry vs the ./v7 and ./v6 subpaths and which exports each carries (app code imports from the root)
Working on the package: bun run check (tsc, Biome, bun test) and the tsup build of the three entries
What the map contains: PrismaMap, ModelEntry, ModelField (scalar | enum | object), IndexEntry, Prisma-name keying, what is not emitted (@db.Text), and when to use the map
A field's default: FieldDefault literal vs generated (now(), uuid(), autoincrement(), dbgenerated), never injected, parsed from @default (matchDefaultAttribute)

Prisma name to database name for SQL: tableName, columnName, storedValue, branded DbIdentifier/DbValue, hasColumn/isScalarField/isEnumField guards, sparse dbName/valueDbNames; never open-code dbName ?? name
List a model's column fields instead of filtering fields by kind: getColumns, pickColumns (strip included relations from a row)
Walk relations: getRelations -> RelationInfo (targetModel, isList, foreignKey), relationForeignKey collapsing fromFields/toFields into an Identifier, null for back-relations
The /// @tagClass(key: value) doc-comment DSL on models, fields and @@index/@@unique/@@id: parseTagClasses, Annotations bag, binding rules, parseSchemaStructure/ModelStructure
